name: standalone_test
description: A genuinely independent ArduPilot SITL instance, hand-launched with its own internal simulator (ardurover --model rover), NOT part of this repo's profiles/ or Gazebo/VRX stack. Exists to prove the resilience tester works against a vehicle this project didn't build. connection/udp_addr point at whatever port the throwaway instance used when this was last run -- update before reuse.
